summary: Excellent test suite comprehensively covering all three retention policies (max-age, keep-latest-N, max-total-size), their interactions, error handling, and determinism. Well-structured across three test files: unit tests for core logic (cleanup.test.ts), workflow structural validation (workflow-structure.test.ts), and end-to-end pipeline tests via act (act-harness.test.ts). Strengths: fixed timestamps enable deterministic testing, comprehensive edge cases (boundaries, tie-breaking, empty inputs), explicit fixture-matching tests assert exact expected values, good error validation. Gaps: CLI argument parsing and file I/O error scenarios rely on act integration tests rather than unit tests; formatting functions (humanSize, formatPlanText, formatPlanMarkdown) not directly tested; suite references fixture files (fixtures/case-*.json) that are not provided in the code, creating a dependency. Strong design with clear test helpers and proper isolation; act harness is complex but appropriate for validating the full GitHub Actions workflow. Would catch regressions effectively across all layers.
